sents.en: Ants are insects.
Butterflies, bees, and mosquitoes are insects too.
Ants live almost everywhere on Earth.
sents.ko: 개미는 지구 거의 모든 곳에 살아요.

sents.en: Most ants live in nests in the ground.
Ants can be black, red, and brown.
sents.ko: 개미는 검은색, 붉은색, 갈색일 수 있어요.

sents.en: Ants can be yellow and green too.
Ants have three main body parts.
They are the head, thorax, and abdomen.
An ant's head has two eyes, a mouth, and two antennae.
sents.ko: 개미 머리에는 눈 두 개, 입, 더듬이 두 개가 있어요.

sents.en: Ants have six legs.
Some ants have wings.
Ants live together in a group called a colony.
sents.ko: 개미는 군집이라는 무리를 이루어 함께 살아요.

sents.en: Each ant has an important job to do in the colony.
Ant colonies have three main members.
sents.ko: 개미 군집에는 크게 세 구성원이 있어요.

sents.en: They are the queen, female workers, and males.
Ants protect plants by eating other insects.
sents.ko: 개미는 다른 곤충을 먹어서 식물을 지켜 줘요.

sents.en: Their underground homes keep the soil healthy.
sents.ko: 개미의 땅속 집은 흙을 건강하게 해 줘요.

sents.en: Ha~ How interesting!
Did you know that ants can fly?
sents.ko: 개미가 날 수 있다는 걸 알았나요?

sents.en: I didn't know that!
This book taught us a lot about ants.
sents.ko: 이 책은 개미에 대해 많이 알려 줬어요.

sents.en: Let's find out what the next book is next time!
I'll see you! Good-bye!
